title: On a phone, the new (i) explanations for privacy and invites can't be opened by a tap
where: /admin/sessions/<code> Overview, 'Send on WhatsApp' and 'Anonymous/Connect session' info icons, 390px
what_happens: Both explanations moved into a Tooltip (Base UI). It opens on hover and keyboard focus (seen: focus shows it at 390px), but Base UI tooltips don't open on a touch tap, so on a phone the text can't be read. Tap behaviour read from the component, not tested on a real phone.
who_hurts: Dane (or an organizer) on a phone deciding whether to switch a session to Connect: he can't read what Connect tells participants before switching.
suggested_fix: Use a Popover (opens on click/tap) for these two info icons instead of Tooltip, or whatever fix the earlier paste-format (i) finding gets, so both work the same way.
rule: established pattern: Dane agreed earlier 'On a phone, the paste-format help behind the (i) icon can't be opened by a tap'
